title: The first moving model of the Wahoo engine.
summary: Selected components become an interactive piston–rod–crank model. A dated decision register preserves the nominal specifications, calculated motion and interfaces still needing verification.
heroAlt: Schematic joint centres and piston travel calculated from the nominal slider-crank reference cycle.
heroCaption: WHE-KIN-001 Rev01 — initial mechanical model. Joint centres and crankpin orbit are schematic; physical part outlines and exhaust behaviour are not represented.

sections.title: From selected parts to a moving mechanism
sections.text: The earlier component baseline and piston-travel study now have an interactive mechanical follow-up. The model uses a rigid, zero-offset slider crank to connect crank angle with piston displacement, velocity and acceleration. This is the first mechanical layer of a virtual prototype, not a calibrated digital twin or a running combustion simulation.

sections.title: Inspect one revolution
sections.text: Move the crank-angle slider, inspect top and bottom dead centre, or play one revolution. Playback takes four seconds for readability; it does not represent actual engine speed. RPM changes the calculated velocity and acceleration. At zero RPM those quantities are zero and playback is disabled. Reduced-motion preferences skip animated playback.

sections.title: The specification baseline, with its evidence status
sections.text: Nominal dimensions remain visible rather than becoming implied manufacturing tolerances. The 102 mm rod reference and the assumed 28 mm crown datum still require exact-part verification. Calculated crown reach does not establish deck height, cylinder-head clearance or installed engine width.

sections.title: Off-the-shelf parts: selected, not yet qualified
sections.text: The sourcing direction retains purchased moving parts and develops the surrounding engine around verified interfaces. The P2018-family rod is included in the complete CS2018 assembly, not an additional installed purchase. References below are carried from the 4 October report; they do not establish stock availability, purchase completion, supplier approval for Wahoo or marine durability.

sections.title: A dated record of the decisions
sections.text: The register preserves the chosen direction, the date it was recorded and its unresolved conditions. Future changes should create a dated revision with a reason and supporting evidence, while retaining this initial snapshot. No purchase, manufacturing release or performance approval is recorded here.

sections.title: What the checks establish
sections.text: The source calculation checks top and bottom dead centre, constant rod-length closure, 360° periodicity, analytic derivatives against independent finite differences, speed scaling, zero speed and invalid inputs. The recorded maximum rod-closure error is approximately 2.84 × 10⁻¹⁴ mm. This confirms numerical consistency under the stated assumptions; it does not validate the physical dimensions, loads, strength, fatigue life or running engine. Website controls are checked separately after adapting the original animation.

sections.title: Where the exhaust enters the next stage
sections.text: Cylinder ports and tuned exhaust must be developed together once actual piston geometry, ring-pin paths and crank interfaces are established. Exhaust geometry, gas temperatures, pressure-wave boundary conditions and the jet-pump load map remain open. This revision contains no exhaust-flow, combustion, cooling or lubrication simulation, and reports no validated torque, power, fuel use or endurance.

sections.title: What needs evidence before the model grows
sections.text: The next work is an exact component-verification register: piston crown contour and volume, compression-height datum, ring locating pins, crank journals, shaft ends, pack width, actual stroke and rod length. Resolve the conflicting MB6322SH2-9TC4 and MB6322C4 main-bearing references before crankcase design. Then establish component masses, cylinder deck and port map, hot clearances, fuel, injection, lubrication and cooling choices. Unknown dimensions remain unresolved rather than being inferred from the animation.
